outputs.refund-window: I don’t know your subscription’s refund window; please check the refund policy in your account’s billing settings or contact support.
outputs.reset-password: On the sign-in page, click **“Forgot password?”**, enter your account email, and follow the reset link sent to you. If you don’t receive it, check your spam folder or your product’s Help Center for account-recovery instructions.
outputs.change-plan: Yes—if annual billing is available for your subscription, you can switch from monthly to yearly in your account’s **Billing** or **Plan** settings. Check that page for the exact change date, prorated credit, and pricing details.
outputs.cancel: Open your account’s **Settings/Billing** page, select **Manage subscription**, then choose **Cancel subscription** and follow the prompts. If you don’t see that option, check your purchase receipt or app-store subscription settings to cancel through the service where you subscribed.
